description: Source code for a Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter in the Eclipse Hono project, implementing REST API endpoints for telemetry, events, and command responses with authentication and CORS support.

classes.name: VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter for Eclipse Hono, handling REST API routes for telemetry, events, and command responses with authentication and CORS support.

methods.name: setUsernamePasswordAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider for device authentication via username and password.

methods.name: setClientCertAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider for device authentication via client certificate.

methods.name: setTenantObjectWithAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider to determine tenant and auth ID from request context.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the protocol adapter type name, 'http'.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Configures API routes for telemetry, event, and command response endpoints with optional authentication.

methods.name: addTelemetryApiRoutes
methods.description: Adds telemetry-related routes with CORS and authentication handling.

methods.name: addEventApiRoutes
methods.description: Adds event-related routes with CORS and authentication handling.

methods.name: addCommandResponseRoutes
methods.description: Adds command response routes with CORS and authentication handling.

methods.name: getDeviceIdParam
methods.description: Extracts device ID parameter from request.

methods.name: getCommandRequestIdParam
methods.description: Extracts command request ID from request.

methods.name: getCommandResponseStatusParam
methods.description: Extracts command response status from request.

methods.name: handlePostTelemetry
methods.description: Handles POST telemetry requests, authenticating device.

methods.name: handlePostEvent
methods.description: Handles POST event requests, authenticating device.

methods.name: handlePostCommandResponse
methods.description: Handles POST command response requests, authenticating device.

methods.name: assertTenant
methods.description: Verifies device tenant matches request tenant, else fails with 403.
